I read both contracted inputs with context_get to get receipts: feat.data_model_change at 3943254 and org.customer_mappings at e8afce8. As background I read the approved feat.design (722a98f) for B1.1, B1.2, B1.4, B1.5, HC-3, DC-1, DC-2, DD-6, DD-7, NF-10 and SE-4. The ap_pipeline code and tests came from the step's tool view, and I read data/sample_feed.csv from the checkout. Where the file names a later step, I cite the skill file that defines it. I compared the latest customer contract (feed v3 columns, paid_date -> Invoice.paid_date, schedule) with the Data Model change field by field. From that I wrote feat.mappings in full: the source-to-target mapping, the ordered transformation steps, the derived Delay-history mapping, the schedule mapping, synthetic validation cases, and open questions, each with a source. Before finishing I had the verifier subagent check every statement in the file against the source it cites. I fixed everything it flagged: the result wording, the paid None-cell behaviour, the citation for no change to pipeline.py, the purity citation, the open-question sources, and the whitespace-only case, which is now an open question with no assumed answer. Mapping is a documentation step and coding is DE-08, so I changed no code. CI passes on the baseline and git status shows a clean working tree.

claims.text: The latest customer contract lists vendor feed v3 columns invoice_id, vendor, due_date, amount, paid, paid_date, with paid_date optional, an ISO date and empty when unpaid, and maps paid_date -> Invoice.paid_date.

The data model change adds Invoice.paid_date (date or None) from feed v3, a new reject reason 'paid_date' and a derived in-memory Delay history view. Feed v2 must keep loading, and no new source or storage is involved.

The existing column mappings stay as they are: invoice_id -> id (strip), vendor -> vendor (strip), due_date -> due_date (date.fromisoformat), amount -> amount (Decimal), paid -> paid ('true' after strip/lower; a missing column means false).

The paid_date rule: a missing column, None or blank gives None. Otherwise the stripped value is parsed with date.fromisoformat. A non-blank invalid value rejects the row with reason 'paid_date'. This check runs only after the existing fields pass.

The Delay history includes only paid records with a paid_date, with delay_days = (paid_date - due_date).days in calendar days. Values are in feed order and negative values are kept. It is in memory only and is consumed by ap_forecast vendor_risk.
ingest.py, dq.py and pipeline.py need no change. quality_report already lists the sorted set of reject reasons, so 'paid_date' appears in it on its own.
The customer schedule (daily 02:00 Asia/Kolkata, unchanged) matches schedule.json (frequency daily, time 02:00, timezone Asia/Kolkata).

DE-07 reads feat.mappings with task.components, DE-08 Coding reads feat.mappings, DE-09 writes the unit tests for the transformation logic, and DE-13 schedules the pipelines from org.customer_mappings.
The repository sample feed still uses the v2 header invoice_id,vendor,due_date,amount,paid, so the v3 cases need synthetic test rows.
This step changes no code: transform.py does not yet map paid_date and there is no delays.py module. TSK-01 and TSK-02 implement the mapping in DE-08.
Monetary amounts stay Decimal, never float, and delays use calendar days.

open_questions: MQ-1 (non-blocking, Data modeler): the customer contract now names the v3 column paid_date. Can CQ-DE4-4 (no v3 specification in the inputs) be closed?

MQ-2 (non-blocking, Product manager / feed owner): the contract says paid_date is 'empty when unpaid', but the model accepts an unpaid row with a valid paid_date and keeps the date (DD-7, OQ-B6). Should such a row be rejected, or its date cleared, instead?

MQ-3 (non-blocking, Product manager / Data engineering lead): the contract gives no effective date for feed v3, and CQ-DE4-1 is still open. Must v2 and v3 feeds load side by side? The mapping accepts both today.

MQ-4 (non-blocking, Data modeler): is a paid_date cell holding only whitespace treated as blank (None) or as invalid (reject with 'paid_date')? The inputs do not name this case. DE-08 must not pick a behaviour silently.
Carried DMQ-1, DMQ-2 and DMQ-3 from feat.data_model_change are unchanged.
structured.summary: I wrote feat.mappings.md in full. The latest customer contract (feed v3) adds one feed-to-Invoice mapping, paid_date -> Invoice.paid_date, and the existing column mappings are unchanged. The data model change also brings one new reject reason, 'paid_date', and the derived in-memory Delay history, which has its own mapping. The contract agrees with the Data Model change on every field, with one wording difference raised as MQ-2. The file sets out the transformation steps in order, a schedule check (daily 02:00 Asia/Kolkata, matching schedule.json) and synthetic validation cases for coding and unit tests. The verifier subagent checked every statement against its source, and I fixed everything it flagged. No code was changed. There are four non-blocking questions (MQ-1 to MQ-4) and no blocking ones.
